questions.question: A series of leaders, known as caliphs, became successors of Muhammad after his death. Who among the following was the first caliph?
Which type of good is purchased by a consumer?
According to the Census, 2011, which of the following union territories has the highest density of population?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (NCT of Delhi) है।

questions.question: There are three main schools of Buddhism: Mahayana, Theravada, and Vajrayana. The Mahayana school is primarily prevalent in which of the following countries?
What does Article 241 say about Union Territories?
options: Special provisions with respect to Delhi
Power of the President to make financial regulations for certain Union Territories
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (High Courts for Union Territories) है।

questions.question: Khair and Khejri trees are found in which type of forest in India?
Which of the following languages serves as the official language of the state of Nagaland?
As per the Constitution of India, which of the following articles deal with citizenship?
In which year did India adopt the social banking and multiagency approach to adequately meet the needs of rural credit?
Who among the following received the Vigyan Ratna Award for lifetime contribution in Science and Technology in 2024?
When did the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) officially come into force as a full-fledged treaty-based inter-governmental international organisation?
Who gave the Indian Social Reform Movement the motto of “Humanize, Equalize and Spiritualize"?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Mahadev Govind Ranade) है।

questions.question: Variation arises mainly due to which two biological processes?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Mutation and recombination) है।

questions.question: The xylem and phloem together form ______.
Parantaka I, who ruled the Chola Empire from 907 to 955 CE, is best remembered for:
options: conquering the island of Sri Lanka and establishing Chola rule in the entire southern peninsula
defeating the Rashtrakutas at Takkolam and expanding his empire towards the northwestern frontier
defeating the Pandya king Maravarman Rajsimha II in the Battle of Vellore and reorganising administration
building new imperial cities such as Gangaikonda Cholapuram and strengthening temple governance
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (defeating the Pandya king Maravarman Rajsimha II in the Battle of Vellore and reorganising administration) है।

questions.question: Which of the following matches is INCORRECT with reference to Alauddin Khalji’s campaign?
भारत के उत्तरी भाग में उच्च दाब क्षेत्र के स्पष्ट आसमान, कम आर्द्रता, हल्की और परिवर्तनशील पवनें भारत में किस ऋतु की विशिष्ट विशेषताएं हैं?
Who set a new Youth World Record at the 2025 Asian Youth Games in Bahrain, by lifting 92 kgs in the Clean & Jerk event of the girls’ 44 kg category?
In which year was the 'Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas' (SVAMITVA) Scheme launched in India to provide the 'Record of Rights' to rural household owners?
The five Zonal Councils of India were established under the _______________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (States Reorganisation Act, 1956) है।
